newsitem.title: POLAND: Norway's king starts visit to trade partner Poland.
newsitem.headline: Norway's king starts visit to trade partner Poland.

text.p: Norway's King Harald V began a state visit on Monday to Poland, his first such trip in Central Europe, reflecting the country's top place in the region as a Norwegian trading partner.
He is accompanied by Norway's foreign and trade ministers, who are to hold talks with Polish counterparts on matters that may include Norwegian oil sales, Polish officials said.
The king began his three-day trip by holding talks with President Aleksander Kwasniewski, whose predecessor Lech Walesa visited Norway last year.

King Harald went to the former Nazi death camp at Auschwitz in southern Poland last year on the 50th anniversary of its liberation and this time will not revisit the site, which is a usual destination for visiting heads of state.

Instead, he will travel on Wednesday to the Baltic port of Gdansk to visit the university there and lay a wreath at a monument to shipyard workers killed in 1970 by communist security forces during protests sparked by food price rises.
